scenarios.description: Solactive accurately calculates and maintains all of its indices. An identified error in Solactive's determination process is corrected by Solactive within a reasonable period of time, and the relevant correction policy is incorporated by reference and available on Solactive's website.
Solactive has an identified error in its determination process, but Solactive does not attempt to correct it at all. The error remains unaddressed indefinitely.

Solactive identifies an error in its determination process and corrects it, but the correction happens after a period that is not described as a reasonable period of time. No other facts about the policy are given.
Solactive identifies an error in its determination process, but the correction is performed by a third party rather than by Solactive. The correction still occurs within a reasonable period of time.
